text.p: Australian United Investments Co Ltd said on Wednesday it planned to raise about A$21.39 million through a 1-for-4 rights issue at A$2.00 per share.
The shares of the investment company last traded at A$2.41 on March 3.
Books for entitlements close on March 25 and the closing date for receipt of acceptances is April 24.

"The directors consider the issue will advantage shareholders by providing them with an opportunity to enlarge their holdings in a successful investment, by increasing liquidity in the market for their company's shares ... and by
providing their company with the ability to invest in new opportunities without having to sell long term investments, many of which pre-date capital gains tax," the company said.

"Proceeds of the issue will be invested over time to the share market on the basis of a similar investment philosophy to that on which the current portfolio has been established, namely to provide income for shareholders with some capital appreciation," the company said.
